0022600191.text: Cleveland (5-4, 4-1 at home) is 2nd in the Central, 1.5 games back, and 6th in the East after a win, while New York (4-4) is 4th in the Atlantic, 3 games back, and 7th in the East on a two-game winning streak. Cleveland is missing Jarrett Allen (knee), Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain), and Sam Merrill (elbow), and New York is without Josh Hart (ankle). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but in 2025-26 Cleveland lost the regular-season series 1-2 and was swept 0-4 in the playoffs, including a 130-93 loss in Cleveland on May 25, 2026.
